## Why This Is Asked
Tests per-namespace scoping, ConfigMap-driven config, and a small policy engine. Exercises InitContainers, Secrets, PVC logging, and network boundaries.

## Key Concepts
- Per-namespace Deployment
- ConfigMap-driven configuration
- Lightweight policy checks (privilege, caps, readOnlyRootFilesystem)
- InitContainer with jq/curl
- Secret-based tokens and PVC-backed logs
- Namespace NetworkPolicy scope

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: namespace-scanner
  namespace: <namespace>
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: namespace-scanner
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: namespace-scanner
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - name: install-tools
        image: alpine:3.18
        command: ["sh", "-c", "apk add --no-progress curl jq"]
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /logs
      containers:
      - name: scanner
        image: myrepo/namespace-scanner:latest
        env:
        - name: PORTAL_URL
          value: "https://compliance-portal/api/v1/scan"
        - name: TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: compliance-portal-token
              key: token
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /logs
      volumes:
      - name: logs
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: compliance-logs
```

- How would you test this policy in CI?
- How would you handle retries and idempotence when posting digests?

## Code Example
```yaml
# CronJob skeleton
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: ns-backup
spec:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          serviceAccountName: backup-sa
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          volumes:
          - name: data
            persistentVolumeClaim:
              claimName: ns-data-pvc
          - name: backup
            emptyDir: {}
          initContainers:
          - name: install-tools
            image: alpine:3.18
            command: ["sh","-c","apk add --no-cache aws-cli tar gzip"]
          containers:
          - name: backup
            image: amazon/aws-cli:2
            command: ["sh","-c","tar czf /backup/namespace.tar.gz -C /data . && aws s3 cp /backup/namespace.tar.gz s3://$(BUCKET)/namespace-$(date +%F).tar.gz"]
            envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: backup-creds
            - configMapRef:
                name: backup-config
            volumeMounts:
            - name: data

            - name: backup
```

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: config-scan
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  schedule: "0 0 * * *"
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 1
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          initContainers:
          - name: yq-installer
            image: busybox:1.36
            command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - |
              wget -O /usr/local/bin/yq https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v4.35.1/yq_linux_amd64
              chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
            volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          containers:
          - name: scanner
            image: curlimages/curl:latest
            command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - |
              for cm in $(kubectl get configmap -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'); do
                kubectl get configmap $cm -o yaml | yq e '.data | keys' - | grep -v '^---\|config.json' && echo "$cm"
              done | curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d @- http://config-scan-portal:8080/api/v1/scan
            env:
            - name: API_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: config-scan-secret
                  key: api-key
            volumeMounts:
            - name: configs
              mountPath: /configs
          - name: tls-sidecar
            image: nginx:alpine
            ports:
            - containerPort: 443
              name: https
            readinessProbe:
              httpGet:
                path: /ready
                port: 443
              initialDelaySeconds: 5
              periodSeconds: 10
            livenessProbe:
              httpGet:
                path: /health
                port: 443
              initialDelaySeconds: 15
              periodSeconds: 20
            volumeMounts:
            - name: tls-certs
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/certs
              readOnly: true
          volumes:
          - name: configs
            persistentVolumeClaim:
              claimName: config-scan-pvc
          - name: tmp
            emptyDir: {}
          - name: tls-certs
            secret:
              secretName: config-scan-tls
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: config-scan-pvc
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadOnlyMany
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: config-scan-secret
  namespace: target-namespace
type: Opaque
stringData:
  api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: config-scan-network-policy
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
```

- **Probes on sidecar**: Adding probes assumes the sidecar exposes health endpoints; this adds configuration overhead but enables reliable deployment in production clusters.

Tests practical security hardening and disruption management capabilities for CKAD-level Kubernetes deployments.

## Key Concepts
- Container SecurityContext: runAsNonRoot, runAsUser, readOnlyRootFilesystem for container isolation
- PodSecurityContext: fsGroup for proper file permissions on PVC-mounted volumes
- Kernel capabilities: drop ALL to minimize attack surface
- PodDisruptionBudget: maintain minimum healthy pods during maintenance
- Rollout and rollback procedures for safe deployments

```yaml
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api-gateway
  labels:
    app: api-gateway
spec:
  replicas: 3

    metadata:

        app: api-gateway

      containers:
      - name: api-gateway
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
```
